title: Chapter 429 Unable To Open
content:
Chapter 429 Unable To Open

Wu Hui stood outside the hall, and also raised his neck and looked up at the void.

"Little fish?"

He murmured, then showed a faint smile.

Just now, Lu Xue had sent someone to tell her guess. Wu Hui was surprised by this guess and thought it was very reasonable.

Although he had never seen that person with his own eyes, it did not hinder his longing for that person.

Now Lu Daosheng's actions once again deeply touched his heart. At this moment, he couldn't help but wonder what kind of existence that person was.

omnipotent?

In the past, he didn't believe that there would be such people in the world. Master Wushang often taught him that there were people outside of people and there was heaven outside of heaven. There was never any omnipotent person. But now, he seems to have changed his view of this. .

If it is possible that there is really an omnipotent person in the world, then this person must be that person.

"Lord of the Palace, do we need to prepare in advance and make some arrangements?"

At this time, Mochou slowly walked behind Wu Hui, with a look of worry.

They knew nothing about the land of the gods, but knew in their understanding that it was a place with higher strength than the Chaos Realm, and there was an existence that claimed to be a god.

A long time ago, the three great gods in the Chaos Realm were the work of the land of the gods.

Although the three great gods have long become the history of the Chaos Realm and dissipated in the long river of time, their influence is still retained in the hearts of the older generation of creatures in the Chaos Realm.

It was a race full of oppression.

If they were defeated this time, they might be enslaved by the land of the gods or directly destroyed.

This is also the reason why Mochou is so worried.

Feeling Mochou's emotions, Wu Hui slowly turned around, looked at Mochou, and whispered, "Mochou, are you afraid of death?"

Hearing this, Mochou did not hesitate and shook his head directly: "Not afraid."

"Mr. Palace Master, I have followed you for many years. Don't you understand me yet? Even if you let me face the land of the gods alone, I dare to go there."

Mochou has already been out of the matter of life and death.

"Then are you worried about the life and death of the sentient beings in the Chaos Realm?"

Wu Hui asked again.

Hearing this question, Mochou hesitated for a moment and whispered, "I don't have that much sentimentality. The entire Chaos Realm is not considered a chaotic world. At most, I am worried about the safety of my human race."

Mochou is also honest. As a member of the human race, he is naturally concerned about the human race. What does the other races in the Chaos Realm have to do with him?

Even if the Chaos Realm wins in the end, only the human race came down. Facing the destruction Chaos Realm race, Mo Chou probably only had a little sympathy.

As long as the human race is fine.

Looking at Mochou, Wu Hui also fell into a brief silence.

This is indeed what Mo Chou said in his heart.

Mochou is not Mochou of the Chaos Realm, he is Mochou of the human race, and Mochou of the Human Emperor Palace.

Mochou is like this, I'm afraid most people in the human race are like this.

Thinking of this, Wu Hui smiled slightly and said, "No matter what the outcome is, we will do our best. At least, this is the case with our human race. As for the Heavenly Demon Clan, the Holy Spirit Clan, etc., what will happen to them is their own choice."

"Own choice?"

Mo Chou repeated this sentence and asked, "District Master, is all this the arrangement of fate?"

"Fate? No."

Wu Hui's voice was firm, "This is not fate. Our own choice, so how could it be fate? There has never been a arrangement of fate. Our destiny must be controlled by ourselves!"

Hearing Wu Hui’s powerful voice, Mo Chou nodded heavily, "Thank you for your teachings from the Palace Master, I already know."

At this time, Mochou no longer had the sorrow he had at the beginning, and replaced it with a hint of confidence.

The fate of the human race is to be grasped by oneself.

No matter what land of gods you can fight against, only our flesh is our spirit, but you will never be able to shake it.

As he thought about it, Mochou even felt that the land of the gods was just like this. After saying goodbye to Wu Hui, Mochou left the Human Emperor Palace with a confident look on his face.

Looking at Mo Chou who left with his relatives unrecognizable steps, Wu Hui was slightly stunned and murmured in his heart, "Am I overpaid?"

.........

"What's the situation? The combat power list next door is about to climax. Why isn't there any movement in this genius list yet?"

In the huge square in the deserted city, Bai Xu stood in an inconspicuous place, looking up from time to time at the list of geniuses in front of him.

But three days passed in a row, and there was no movement in the list of geniuses. No matter how many geniuses shouted, the list of geniuses never lit up.

"Boy, you may have to be prepared to not be able to open this genius list for the time being."

A sound came from Bai Xu's wrist.

Hearing this, Bai Xu's face changed slightly, "Senior, why can't the combat power list be opened, and why can't the Tianjiao list?"

"These two lists clearly appeared together."

The ancient bracelet trembled slightly, "Bai Xu, I have guessed some of the intentions of this combat power list. This should be a tool to inspire the powerful people in the Chaos Realm to become stronger and fight spirit."

"Only in this way, there is a little more chance of victory among the strong people in the land of the gods."

"It is obvious that even if Huangcheng is not sure about this time, it requires relying on the strong men of the Chaos Realm."

Listening to Senior Hao's words, Bai Xu nodded, but frowned slightly, "Senior Hao, what do you say have to do with not opening the Tianjiao List?"

I just heard the bracelet continue: "The intention of the combat power list is to help top-level strong men improve their strength, which can provide great help for the near future battle."

"As for the Tianjiao List, the Tianjiao List is also to help Tianjiao improve its strength, but Tianjiao is just a Tianjiao after all."

"The genius who has not grown up is useless."

"The talented genius, but the genius who died halfway through the road, can be said to be countless in the entire history. Even if the wasteland city is rich and powerful, how could he choose to invest in a genius who will not have any effect in a short period of time?"

Senior Hao's words made Bai Xu dull for a moment.

It turns out that the reason why the Tianjiao List was not opened is because Tianjiao had no effect in the subsequent battle.

After Bai Xu reacted, a helpless and bitter smile appeared on his face.

I am still too young. If I were born tens of thousands of years ago, I might have the ability to make it to the combat power list, rather than waiting for the list of geniuses that cannot be opened here.

"Boy, you don't have to be too discouraged. Although the list of geniuses cannot be opened for the time being, as a holy land, there are still many opportunities in the deserted city, so you don't have to waste time here."

Hearing this, Bai Xu also came back to his senses.

Yes, before I came to Huangcheng, I had never thought about this so-called genius list.

Speaking of which, this list of geniuses is just an accident.
